# Wend

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Wend
```

## Description

Ends a [While](While) loop and goes back to test its condition.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 0
While n < 2
	n = n + 1
Wend
Print n
```

```text
2
```
